messages:
anita: Schedule check 1. Deploy window request for 2026-03-23 01:50-03:00 UTC. We're pushing runtime v2.15.0, api v3.3.0, router v1.10.0, console v0.24.0. Need pins to avoid partial rollouts across regions.

anita: Change summary: runtime - transient mem leak fix and eviction tuning; api - auth token TTL harmonization; router - split header routing improvements; console - telemetry opt-in flag behind feature gate.

anita: Proposed rollout order (staged wave): runtime -> api -> router -> console. We'll do 1% canary per region for first 5 minutes, then 5% for 10m, then global ramp.

deploy-bot: starting integrated preflight for release 2.15.0 (triggered by @anita). Checking pinned-variants and cross-service compatibility...

deploy-bot: preflight result: schema compatibility OK, pinned-variants: runtime@2.15.0, api@3.3.0, router@1.10.0, console@0.24.0, no schema migrations detected.

mike: quick Q 1: do we have automatic rollback thresholds in the orchestrator, or is this manual?

anita: orchestrator has auto-abort for severe signals but plan is manual cutover. Auto-abort thresholds: 3m sustained p95 latency > 2x baseline OR error-rate > 2% for any production route. Manual triggers: memory growth >10% over baseline on runtime, KV eviction spike > 0.3% (ops), or header-split mismatch >1%.

tara: router note: the header-split backoff exists but only per-zone. We'll add an orchestrator healthcheck that evaluates global header mismatch and will pause if above 0.8% for 2 minutes.

ben: ops request: add a 20m telemetry verification after router ramp so APM/correlation keys look good. Also request for a short synthetic test that exercises auth TTL change for a subset of clients.

anita: added 20m probe gate post-router. Synthetic auth probe will run at 10s cadence for the first 5 minutes of api canary.

sre-oncall: I'll be on standby 01:30-03:30 UTC. If we hit rollback, what is recovery path?

anita: recovery path: 1) pause orchestrator job orch-7360012222; 2) pin services to previous stable variants across all regions; 3) force-canary-evac to clear canary pods; 4) run smoke and tracing checks. We'll post a customer note if impact >2min.

deploy-bot: orchestrator job created: orch-7360012222. Canaries configured per-region with fallback routing policy set to "hedged". Attachments: config-diff, rollout-playbook.

mike: good to have the revert commands in-runbook. Also confirm console will not flip telemetry collector until manual approval.

anita: console will be paused in orchestrator and require an explicit "collector.flip" step in the runbook. No auto-flip.

platform: flagged: change window reserved and incident channel #incidents prepped. Support rotation assigned to @tara and @ben for first-hour coverage.

anita: runbook snippet with quick revert steps (ops aliases):
```
# quick rollback steps for orch-7360012222
orchctl pause orch-7360012222
orchctl pin runtime=2.14.9 api=3.2.8 router=1.9.6 console=0.23.7
opsctl evac --canaries orch-7360012222 --wait 30s
ops-run smoke-check --targets api runtime router
```

ben: small ask: include the exact grafana dashboard panels and alert links in the runbook so oncall can hit the right screens.

anita: done. I've added direct links and the alert runbook for KV eviction and header mismatch.

deploy-bot: preflight completed: no blocking checks. Orchestrator job scheduled to start 2026-03-23T01:55:00Z. Progress updates will be posted to this thread.

mike: I'll publish canary metrics at each gate.

tara: support note posted. Incident rota live.

sre-oncall: standby confirmed.

anita: thanks all 1. We'll proceed on the scheduled time. Ping here when you see the orchestrator kick off. :rocket:
